_readme: The WilsonWorks agents anyone can install, with: node agents/bin/install-agent.js <key>. node agents/bin/agent.js catalog lists them and says which are installed. The installer (install.js) offers the first one that has an offer line, and installs any of them without asking with --agent <key>, or several with --agent louise,tony,cbfc. An optional "private" names the part of an agent that is not in this public repo (a private repo, or a program installed on its own): the installer checks it, says plainly when it is missing, and never installs it. Each source is the agent's package: a git address, a folder or a .zip file. agents/lib/catalog.js reads this file; WW_AGENT_CATALOG points at another one (for tests and drills), where a relative source is read from that file's own folder.

agents.name: Louise
agents.title: The Research Librarian
agents.line: Researches your questions with a source for every fact, and keeps what she finds on shelves you can browse.
agents.offer: Louise, the research librarian, can move into your office now. Install her?

agents.name: Tony
agents.title: The Accountant
agents.line: Keeps the books with you: sorts bank lines, codes them, closes the month, and leaves the live money to a person. This is his basic setup; his full training is private.

private.how: Add it in Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add wilson-works/accountant-tony, then claude plugin install the-accountant-tony@the-accountant-jev
private.ask: Ask the firm's office manager for access if you need it.

agents.name: CBFC
agents.title: The Academy
agents.line: A door in your office that opens the CBFC Academy on this computer. The Academy itself is private to the firm and installed on its own.

private.how: Install it with the CBFC Academy install guide and its ZIP in the firm's Google Drive (ask the firm's office manager). CBFC's door opens it after that.

agents.name: Bryn
agents.title: The Trail Guide
agents.line: Helps you think a decision through. Five scouts weigh it on their own, she looks for where the plan could fail, and she keeps your call so you never argue it twice.

agents.name: James and John's Coworking Space
agents.title: The CTO org's office
agents.line: Tell James and John what you need. They read your projects, plan the work as a run for your team of agents, and hand you the steps. You start the lanes.

agents.name: Kindlemere
agents.title: Avo, Steady and Tumble by the lake
agents.line: Three keepers in a park by a lake: Avo plans your meals and shopping, Steady your workouts and stretches, Tumble your dog's training and play.
